body:
## Purpose

Define the LandmarkSignal Hermes Bot roster.

## Current Operating Environment

For this phase, LandmarkSignal will use **Hermes Agent rather than Hermes Desktop** as the active operating environment.

## Initial Planned Bots

- Argus (domain lead)
- LMS-Coder
- LMS-Security
- LMS-Reviewer
- LMS-Research

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Bot definitions documented
- [ ] Bot responsibilities defined
- [ ] Bot creation tasks created
- [ ] Roster approved
- [ ] Definitions are compatible with Hermes Agent

## Notes

Do not create the Bots as part of this issue. This issue defines what needs to be created.
